review:
Gates of Olympus Super Scatter is a special edition of the classic pay-anywhere slot. Eight to 30 matching symbols anywhere on the grid win, wins tumble away, and Zeus's multiplier orbs worth up to 500x can land on any spin, with several orbs added together.

Four or more scatters start 15 free spins where every multiplier on a winning spin joins a running total for the rest of the round. The new Super Scatter changes the trigger: one in the triggering spin pays 100x instantly, two pay 500x, three 5,000x and four the 50,000x maximum. It suits fans of the original who want a bigger ceiling.
